verdict.rationale: Zep docs list LiveKit among supported agent frameworks and highlight sub-200ms context retrieval, which is relevant to real-time voice use cases, but there is no evidence of documented integrations with Pipecat or ElevenLabs, nor any voice-pipeline-specific integration guide or latency benchmarks for that context. Missing for 10: Pipecat and ElevenLabs integration docs, a dedicated voice-pipeline quick-start, and independent/hands-on confirmation that latency is sufficient for live conversation.
